quests.name: Preventative Care
quests.desc: Squash 5 Debt Mites before they compound.
quests.offer: The mites are biting again. Squash five for me and the clinic stays quiet. Preventative care, comrade.
quests.done_line: Five fewer vectors of usury. The clinic thanks you — take this.

quests.name: Field Research
quests.offer: The walls are a syllabus. Read three passages and report back. There WILL be a discussion section.
quests.done_line: Well read! The wall speaks and you listened. Extra credit, and a zine.

quests.name: Redistribution
quests.offer: Hoarded wealth rots, dear. Crack three chests open and let it circulate.
quests.done_line: Circulation restored. The commons grows. Your cut, fair and square.

quests.name: Bring Them Home
quests.desc: Recruit a fighter to your side.
quests.offer: Nobody fights alone on my watch. Find a comrade out there and bring them into formation.
quests.done_line: That's the doctrine: nobody alone. Carry the banner for them.

quests.name: Material for the Ballad
quests.offer: The next ballad needs verses and verses need VILLAINS FALLING. Ten of them. Make it rhythmic.
quests.done_line: ♪ And down came ten, to the people's cheer ♪ — it's already a hit. Coffee's on me.

quests.name: Pest Control
quests.offer: Three slimes have been oozing brand synergy on my mushrooms. The zucchini can't hold forever.
quests.done_line: The garden is ad-free once more. Seeds for the liberator.

quests.name: Clear the Hall
quests.offer: Corridor east of here's full of freeloading landlords. Clear eight out and I'll fix that draft. I tell you what.
quests.done_line: Clean hall, clean burn. Take these — dropped a water heater in 'em once, good as new.

quests.name: Sample Collection
quests.offer: I need venom samples from four Payday Pythons. For science. And *urp* a little for spite.
quests.done_line: Beautiful specimens. Their APR was 400%. Their survival rate: lower. Here, potion.

quests.name: The Census
quests.offer: The Mud Collective requires a census! Speak with four comrades. Democracy is mostly attendance.
quests.done_line: Census complete! Motion to celebrate carries unanimously. Bread for the enumerator.
